title: Validate batch files against a declared contract and account for every row
problem: A loader that drops rows it cannot parse makes every downstream number quietly wrong. The contract a file must satisfy usually lives only in the loader's code, so nobody can review it, and a malformed header is discovered only after half a batch is loaded.
context: This is the first task of a learner-authored forge project. No source exists yet. The learner creates the repository, writes a small generator for synthetic batch files, and owns every design decision inside the specification's constraints.
impact: Every later guarantee, idempotence, ordering and the quality report, is stated in terms of rows this task accepts or rejects.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A seeded generator produces synthetic delimited batch files, including rows with missing required fields, bad types, and duplicate keys within a batch.
Columns, types, required fields and the record key are declared in a data file and validated before use.
A file whose header does not match the contract is refused before any row is processed, naming the missing or unexpected columns.
Each invalid row is rejected with a reason and written to a quarantine output. Rows read equals rows accepted plus rows rejected.
A batch whose rejected share exceeds a declared threshold is refused as a whole.
Automated tests cover a clean batch, a header mismatch, each kind of row rejection, and the threshold. All pass at the submitted revision.
The learner explains the choice of record key, one rejected alternative, and what an analyst would see downstream if rejected rows were silently dropped.

constraints: Standard library, including sqlite3 and csv, plus a test runner only. No ORM, dataframe or validation library.
Do not load anything into a database yet. This task ends at validated, accounted-for rows.
Do not push to a remote or open a pull request as part of this task.

scope.description: One input boundary, its contract and its accounting.

investigation_areas: Which properties of a row make it the same record as another row
Which contract violations should reject a row and which should reject the whole batch
What a reject reason needs to say for someone to fix the source
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design.
documentation_requirements: Record the contract format, the record key and the rejected alternative in the learner design.
